name: Powered_Concrete
title: Powered Concrete
author: Squishy1870; original mod by JuneGame
description: Powered Concrete adds powered versions of concrete, refined concrete, and hazard concrete so your factory floor can carry electric coverage without visible power poles. Factorio 2.0 compatible with clean visible floor recipes, exact tile-by-tile power, Q/pipette support, and hidden conversion recipes kept out of the crafting UI.
